svg.title: A flag you can replay
svg.desc: A risk signal about a same-amount in/out pair marked medium severity traces to rule PANINI-FRD-CIRC-001, which cites two transactions: txn 12, a debit of 40,000 rupees on 3 March, and txn 31, a credit of 39,500 rupees on 5 March from the same counterparty, located on page 2 of the source statement with the balance chain verified. Illustrative example.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every risk signal traces to the rule that fired and the exact statement rows behind it.
